description: Abstract class defining URI scheme validation logic within the HTMLPurifier library. It specifies properties and methods for validating URI components for different schemes, including default port, security, and browsability.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a blueprint for URI scheme validators in the HTMLPurifier library, handling validation logic and scheme properties.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of URI components, applying default behaviors and then calling the scheme-specific doValidate method.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for specific URI scheme validation.
